scope: Cell pellets were lysed in 50 μL of 25 mM ammonium bicarbonate (AB, Fluka) buffer containing 1.1 % sodium dodecyl sulfate (SDS, Sigma), 0.3 % sodium deoxycholate (Sigma), protease inhibitor cocktail (Sigma) and phosphatase inhibitor cocktail (Merck).

Homogenates were subjected to centrifugation (12 °C, 10000 rpm, 5 min). Lysates were added to 150 μL of digest buffer (1.33 mM CaCl2, Sigma, in 25 mM AB) containing immobilized trypsin beads (Perfinity Biosciences) and shaken at 1400 rpm overnight at 37 °C.
